package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"

	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for transaction_object_crosses_more_than_one_layer_boundary: Transaction handles passed through multiple layers as ordinary arguments.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type CreateOrderHandler struct {
	svc *OrderService
}

func (h *CreateOrderHandler) Handle(db *gorm.DB, userID, amount int) error {
	tx := db.Begin()
	if tx.Error != nil {
		return tx.Error
	}
	if err := h.svc.CreateOrder(tx, userID, amount); err != nil {
		tx.Rollback()
		return err
	}
	return tx.Commit().Error
}

type OrderService struct {
	repo *OrderRepo
}

func (s *OrderService) CreateOrder(tx *gorm.DB, userID, amount int) error {
	if amount <= 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid amount: %d", amount)
	}
	return s.repo.InsertOrder(tx, userID, amount)
}

type OrderRepo struct{}

func (r *OrderRepo) InsertOrder(tx *gorm.DB, userID, amount int) error {
	return tx.Exec("INSERT INTO orders (user_id, amount) VALUES (?, ?)", userID, amount).Error
}
